Name: Stardual Valley - Dual Screen for Stardew
Author: eloteenthusiast
Description:
[center][size=5][b]Stardual Valley[/b][/size]
[i]A comprehensive dual screen experience for Stardew Valley[/i][/center]
[center][/center]

Works with Cinderbox (and most likely other Android-based launchers).

The second screen is drawn with Stardew's own window frames, fonts and icons, taken from your copy of the game while it runs, so it matches the top screen.

[line]

[size=4][b]Second Screen Content:[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Main:[/b] time, weather, luck, gold, energy, health, buffs and your whole backpack, with touch controls to select, move, sort and eat items. Drag and drop to rearrange items or equip and unequip your hat, clothes, boots, rings and trinket[/*]
[*][b]Map:[/b] the world map with villagers on it (works with NPC Map Locations)[/*]
[*][b]Farm:[/b] crops to water or harvest, machines, animals, fruit trees and planting deadlines for the seeds you are carrying[/*]
[*][b]Journal, Bundles, Calendar:[/b] quests, what each bundle still needs, birthdays and festivals[/*]
[*][b]People:[/b] hearts, gifts given this week, who you have talked to today[/*]
[*][b]Crafting:[/b] every recipe you know, with the ones you can make right now listed first[/*]
[*][b]Progress:[/b] skill levels, the professions you picked, Mastery, museum donations and how deep you have been in the mines[/*]
[*][b]Wiki:[/b] search any item, villager, shop, fish or place. Built from the game's own data, so it works offline and includes modded items[/*]
[*][b]Cheats[/b] (experimental and optional, off by default): freeze time, walking speed, weather, warps, open any door, hearts, add items[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Other Features:[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Hide the game's HUD[/b] on the top screen and let the second screen show it instead[/*]
[*][b]Inventory bar:[/b] with the HUD hidden, switching slots or rows pops up your current row for a moment, on the second screen or as the game's own toolbar on the top screen[/*]
[*][b]L and R[/b] still switch backpack rows while the HUD is hidden[/*]
[*][b]Backdrops:[/b] an animated sky that follows the in-game time and weather, plus others to choose from[/*]
[*][b]Customizable:[/b] hide tabs you do not use, fold away sections, and choose what the mod shows[/*]
[*][b]Private:[/b] the second screen only talks to the game on the same device. Nothing is reachable from your network[/*]
[/list][line]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0 or later[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Notes[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Built and tested on an AYN Thor. Other setups have not been tried yet, so reports are welcome![/*]
[*]Some info may be outdated or incorrect. If you discover any errors or bugs, please share them here![/*]
[*]It seems to play nice with Stardew Valley Expanded, though let me know if you hit any issues[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Credits[/b][/size]
Profmags' Stardew Dual Screen mod was used for the game-reading code with permission
